messages:
mike-ops: Heads up — ACME (acct acme-corp) just escalated: objects with TTL expired yesterday are still showing up in search, legal needs deletion timeline. ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/789 :warning:
kevin-ng: can you paste one or two object IDs and the API call they used? also, any errors in the audit log?
mike-ops: obj IDs: obj_9a3f, obj_b12c. customer used DELETE /v1/objects/{id} which returned 202. they also ran a direct query via our search API and still got results. audit shows several KMS entries around the same time: `kms:decrypt FAILED` (snippet below).
mike-ops: ```
2024-08-12T01:22:11Z audit_id=xyz user=svc_acme action=delete object=obj_9a3f status=accepted
2024-08-12T01:22:12Z kms_key=arn:aws:kms:... status=DECRYPT_ERROR err=key_not_available
2024-08-12T01:22:13Z deletion_queue enqueue obj=obj_9a3f status=enqueued
2024-08-12T01:22:20Z search index showed object obj_9a3f present
```
tara_w: quick check — is this a default retention case or custom retention for ACME? default is 90d, customers can set overrides. if the TTL was changed recently we need that in the timeline.
mike-ops: cust had default 90d. the object TTL (metadata) shows expired 2024-08-11T23:59:59Z. No recent policy edits in the account activity log.
samira: I see a transient backlog from 2024-08-12 01:15-01:30 where deletion workers lagged. related to a KMS maintenance window — there was an HSM key rotation event at 01:20 that briefly changed key state.
samira: possible cause: deletion worker attempted to encrypt tombstone or access KMS-wrapped key and got DECRYPT_ERROR while HSM rekeying. that would leave items enqueued but not tombstoned.
legal-team: Legal here — please *do not* proceed with irreversible deletion until we confirm. we need a hold if there's any chance of litigation. can you confirm whether objects can be exported now (audit log + raw copies)?
kevin-ng: mike — can you run a repro that hits the deletion queue and dump the deletion worker logs (include X-Request-ID) and also try `curl -i -X DELETE` with header `X-Force-Delete: true` in a sandbox to see if tombstone step succeeds? please redact customer PII. command: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Request-ID: repro-$(date +%s)" -H "X-Force-Delete: true" -X DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/obj_9a3f```
mike-ops: ran repro in staging using same key alias — DELETE returned 202, deletion-worker log shows: `worker_id=del-7 attempt=1 obj=obj_9a3f status=kms_decrypt_failed`. tried again 30s later with same result.
deployer-bot: HSM rotation job completed at 2024-08-12T01:21:05Z. job_id=rot-20240812-01 :white_check_mark:
samira: thanks — that rotation completion explains the window. we need KMS team to confirm key availability for tombstoning and whether re-enqueue will resume normal deletion. I'll open an infra incident and tag them.
samira: incident: https://redwood.internal/infra/INC-4521 — adding logs and sample object IDs. priority: P1 for legal hold question.
legal-team: added litigation hold flag request for ACME in case management. please preserve raw audit logs and snapshots until legal OK.
kevin-ng: next steps for the support runbook: 1) preserve current state (snapshots of object storage + audit logs) 2) get KMS team confirmation on key state + replay plan 3) do not mark as permanently deleted until legal clears 4) run targeted requeue after KMS confirms availability and verify tombstone present via `/v1/internal/tombstones/{id}` endpoint.
mike-ops: acknowledged. I have preserved storage snapshot and exported audit logs to the incident. I will wait for KMS confirmation before requeue. blocking ask: KMS team — can you confirm whether the rotation produced any orphaned key versions that would block tombstone writes? pinging @samira for handoff.
samira: pinged KMS on INC-4521. they replied preliminary: "rotation created new key version; old version pending archival for ~30m. deletions attempted during the transition return DECRYPT_ERROR until archival completes." they estimate clearance by 2024-08-12T01:55Z.
mike-ops: noted — told customer we have a hold and are preserving evidence. legal thanked us.
kevin-ng: when KMS confirms, run the requeue flow and paste the tombstone endpoint output. sample tombstone check: `GET /v1/internal/tombstones/obj_9a3f` -> `{"obj_id":"obj_9a3f","tombstoned":true,"tombstone_ts":"2024-08-12T01:58:10Z"}`
legal-team: thanks all. keep thread updated. if KMS clearance slips, we'll discuss extended litigation hold. :thumbsup:
mike-ops: will update — closing loop when tombstone verified.
